result: Wrote the parent synthesis at `index.md` with cover.svg drafted by scout-illustrator. Cross-cutting themes: the walk-home constraint binds lodging to the Troisgros estate, lodging villages double as activity destinations (Ouches/Villerest/Cordelle reappear; only Pradines doesn't), Sunday closures (cellars, Charlieu market) decide the itinerary, and the tech angle is empty outside the Oct 2–12 Fête de la Science window. Flagged the unresearched gap: dinner mechanics (price, lead time, dress code, room-package logic) were never given their own sub-topic despite the brief.
